findings.evidence: ROOT_STAGE_HANDOFF.md B1/B2/B3 use E/S; PROTOCOL_B_CONTROLS.md also uses vector energies.
findings.resolution: Literal B contract/analysis must explicitly define primary E as squared finite she-minus-he margin prediction error and S as squared finite native margin change, in logit squared. Vector endpoint energy is secondary and must have distinct fields. Fixed primary hypotheses and precision-in-logits source make the intended target recoverable; this does not change design.

findings.evidence: PROTOCOL_A.md still says no canonical contract exists and before any FIT requires numeric N; frozen A_fit_primary_v1 already amends this.
findings.resolution: ROOT_STAGE_HANDOFF.md explicitly makes frozen running A protocol authoritative. Implementer must use exact frozen A contract, never treat stale generic preparation status as a reason to repeat or mutate its inputs.

findings.evidence: Handoff specifies one JVP per recipient/operator but no execution implementation or method-level schedule yet.
findings.resolution: Future literal schedule must charge actual JVP/autodiff primal and derivative work, native endpoints, TC base/endpoints, gradient forward/backward and full patched remainder forwards separately; reuse durable endpoints and never add independent repeated sweeps. This is an explicit remaining gate, not permission to launch.

remaining_gates: Exact B literal FIT contract/schedule/model and TC identities with all transitive dependencies.
Random-model B derivative and replacement-equivalence tests; trained sham/positive and branch/full-margin parity before expansion.
Public TC independent reference parity including JumpReLU threshold, affine skip, output normalization and dtype. Metadata match alone is insufficient.
Predeclared finite-difference/JVP settings, actual rounding-scale diagnostics, numeric gates and accounting.
Independent reviewed inferential eligibility, power/precision selector calibration and numeric targets before PILOT; independent TEST pre-run review.
Stability precision goal and independent calibration before fifteen additional A FIT cohorts.
limitations: Read-only source review; no pretrained loading, inference, calibration mutation, B worker execution or launch. Existing operators/baselines/TC are partial implementation, not an end-to-end B pipeline. The current B worker and literal B operation schedule are absent. Statistical code was inspected for intended paired/IUT/Holm/crossed behavior, not certified calibrated by this review. Design source copies are frozen here; edits elsewhere require a new source snapshot/review.
